Current guide explicitly lists Resolve Free or Studio. This is provider documentation, not independent installation testing.
Targets differ by OS: Apple Silicon on macOS, x64 on Windows. The unscoped architecture filter is left unknown to avoid claiming every OS/CPU combination.
macOS DMG/Activator and manual Windows MSI; follow the original verification and installation instructions.
FIT and video processing remain local. License checks and optional account imports use the network; optional weather sends location/time and the user-supplied key to OpenWeather.
One-time major-version license; seven-day trial. Paid use permits up to ten consecutive days offline between successful checks. Optional OpenWeather usage is separate.
Provider history identifies 1.1.27, build 202611191. No date is inferred from the build label.
Windows download page explicitly lists 1.1.27 and build 202611191 and states that the version/license are shared with macOS.

Builds editable activity-data gauges in Resolve from FIT files, including pace, speed, heart rate, power and route. Supports local FIT import on Apple Silicon macOS and Windows x64. Paid one-time major-version license with a seven-day trial. Activation and periodic license checks need internet; optional weather sends activity location/time to OpenWeather and may incur separate charges.
